item.title: Man shot and killed by Nash County deputy after pointing AR-style rifle: Sheriff

item.description: A man is facing a murder charge in connection with another man's death in Smithfield this week, a warrant shows.

item.title: Former NC State students and staff file lawsuit against chemical company over Poe Hall contamination
item.description: A month after taking legal action against North Carolina State University over the toxic chemical exposure in Poe Hall, former students and staff have filed a lawsuit against a chemical company connected to the building.

item.title: FBI asks public to come forward in probe of ex-Raleigh officer accused of sex crimes
item.description: Federal, state, and local law enforcement agencies are asking the public to come forward as part of an ongoing investigation into a former Raleigh police officer accused of committing sex-related crimes while on duty, FBI officials said Thursday.

item.title: Progress made between DPS and DAE on collective grievance policy, worker pay negotiations continue
item.description: DURHAM, N.C. (WNCN) — Durham Public Schools leaders and members of the Durham Association of Educators say they made progress during one of the final meet-and-confer meetings of the school year Thursday night. The attendees came to an agreement on language for the district’s grievance policy and continued negotiations over employee pay and working conditions. [...]
